name: media-guard
description: Prevents Antigravity session freezes caused by embedding raw video/audio binaries in conversation history. Enforces balanced PreToolUse read_file guards, subagent isolation, and ffmpeg preprocessing.
author: holoiallo
suggestedPrompts: 用 media-safe-read 安全分析这段本地视频
用 prep_media.mjs 裁剪视频指定片段或提取关键帧
检查当前媒体文件大小并决定走子代理还是预处理
